key_point: The day players killed the king
title: The day players killed the king
caption: In 1997, a player killed Lord British, the god-like avatar of Ultima's creator. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #ultimaonline #origin

instagram.caption:
During an Ultima Online beta event in 1997, the game's creator Richard Garriott appeared as Lord British, the untouchable king.

A server crash had reset his invulnerability and he forgot to turn it back on. A player named Rainz cast a fire field and killed him in front of everyone.

The other developers summoned demons on the crowd in response. Players still tell the story as the most famous moment in MMO history.

Would you have dared to try?
